title: Serial Walmart Shoplifters Face Off with Georgia Cops
description:
A couple was arrested after allegedly shoplifting from a Walmart in Forsyth, Georgia. The duo, Meagan Clay, 21, and Todd Pope, 25, were caught after Asset Protection Officers recognized them and called police, according to the Forsyth Police Department. When searching the pair officers found paint brushes that bodycam video shows Meagan admitting to taking, but Walmart employees noted that the pair were seen in the store the night before allegedly swiping a jacket that the suspect was currently wearing. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
